name: Olsalazine Sodium

similar.name: Exifone
problems: Pulled from the market in France, first in 1989 — for liver harm

fda.text: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS • Renal Impairment : Assess renal function at the beginning of treatment and periodically during treatment. Discontinue DIPENTUM if renal function deteriorates while on therapy. ( 5.1 , 7.1 ) • Mesalamine-Induced Acute Intolerance Syndrome : Discontinue treatment if acute intolerance…

summary: A small computer model, not tests on people, gave Olsalazine Sodium a medium risk score of 50 for liver issues and a low risk score of 11 for heart issues [M]. A similar drug named Exifone was pulled from the market in France in 1989 due to liver harm [3]. Official warnings state that kidney function, meaning how well the kidneys work, should be checked before and during treatment, and the medicine must be stopped if the kidneys worsen [4]. Treatment must also be stopped if a person experiences sudden intolerance syndrome [4].
